name: deSEC Free DNS
free_limit: Free authoritative DNS hosting with automatic DNSSEC and REST API; one dedyn.io hostname per account; bring-your-own domains subject to per-account quota; authenticated API limited to 2,000 requests/day.
watch_out: No domain registration or commercial SLA. Domain creation is quota-controlled, and DNS record writes have per-domain rate limits (300/day); paid third-party domain registration may be needed. Commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.
